name: pulse
description: A slim band above the prompt: session cost, spend rate and budget, running time, warm or cold prompt cache, context fill and low usage limits, with Pip and a details pane.

budget.title: Session budget (USD)
budget.description: The cost turns amber at 80% of it and red past it. 0 leaves it off.

coldWarning.title: Warn before the cache goes cold
coldWarning.description: A toast 5 minutes before an hour-long cache expires, 1 minute before a 5-minute one.
